name: hope-commit
description: Review local Git commits as evidence-linked offline HTML, alongside Hope's original alignment, maintenance, review, PR explanation, and writing skills. Requires Node.js 22 or newer.

interface.shortDescription: Review one Git commit as a grounded offline HTML artifact
interface.longDescription: Commit Diff reads one immutable local Git commit, compares it with a selected parent, and produces an evidence-linked offline HTML review without reading worktree changes. This unofficial fork also retains Hope's original skills and credits the original project and author.
defaultPrompt: Use $hope-commit:commit-diff to review this commit as offline HTML.
Use $hope-commit:align to build a shared understanding before implementation.
